title: Slam 'n Jam '96 featuring Magic & Kareem: Signature Edition
overview:
It's Showtime!

- Magic and Kareem are back! Dish the no-look pass or post up to sink the 'sky-hook'.
- Call plays: isolate players, set picks, and double-team on defense.
- Substitute players from a deep bench.
- Track team, game, and league leaders' stats.
- Bang the boards in the Franchise-Player mode: be the go-to-guy for the entire game.
- Up to four players.
- View instant replays from multiple angles.
- Supercharged commentary of sports favorite, Van Earl Wright.
